about_the_game:
The Trail is an homage to classic RPGs, with some new twists. Explore the world, uncover mysteries, hone your skills, and look good doing it! Do you have what it takes to break the ancient cycle and stop Apocalypse?

See The Sights.

The Overworld is vast, featuring 200+ unique maps filled to the brim with content and secrets. You can hunt for the rarest accessories, fill up your quest journal, and defeat the strongest of bosses! There are over 500+ items, each with their own purpose... will you find them all?

Break The Cycle.

Apocalypse's return threatens to bring upon the end of the Overworld. As a member of the Champion Program, you'll encounter a diverse cast of characters: a bandit-turned-friend, a self-concious monarch, and even a guy who talks to cows. Many of them have recurring appearances throughout the game!

Save The World.

Battle a wide range of enemies in dynamic turn-based combat. Fighting is not just about selecting the default attack; it is about well-timed strikes, adapting to the enemy, and exploiting any weakness you can find. Each encounter is fast-paced by default, and if you're able to master certain strategies, nothing will stand in your way!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 14.04 or Steam OS 2.0 (64 bit)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: Mac OSX 10.10 or better
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGLR
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: We were cut off from heaven hundreds of thousands of years ago. Since then, the corrupted soul of an evil god has wrought constant terror and destruction upon us. Will you be able to defy the prophecy and finally save the Overworld from its endless cycle of evil?
